title: eranthemum roseum
intro: Eranthemum roseum, commonly known as Blue Pilea, is a flowering plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia and Australia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and alleviate symptoms of fever. The plant's therapeutic actions include its antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These compounds have been shown to have potential applications in the treatment of various diseases, including cancer, cardiovascular disease, and neurodegenerative disorders.
